Who is Bruno Giacomelli?

Bruno Giacomelli (born 10 September 1952 in Poncarale, Brescia, Lombardy, Italy) is a retired racing driver from Italy. Débuting at the 1977 Italian Grand Prix, Giacomelli drove eight seasons of Formula One from to , driving for , , and . He scored one pole position and took one podium.
